verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state OpenCode's GitHub integration will work in a new branch and submit a PR with all changes, implying it can stage changes, create branches, and open PRs (opencode-docs-12). However, there's no explicit mention of commit message authoring workflow details or independent hands-on verification of the full stage→commit→branch→PR flow, and permission gating (auto-approve vs prompts) adds friction that isn't fully documented for this specific workflow. missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of the commit+branch+PR flow working end-to-end, explicit documentation of commit message generation, detail on how permissions interact with git actions.
